qa_eos_usage: evaluation only; not added to training loss
pairing: single: one ordinary noise/one member; noise: 96 ordinary noises/one member; set: same 96 ordinary noises/96 fixed members
initialization: fresh pretrained DreamLite plus seeded zero-output LoRA for every distinct stage/rank; budget extension alone resumes optimizer
scope: same-question learnability; no unseen-question or counterfactual event claim
multi_question_stage: requires a separate approved multi-question teacher bank; not fabricated from this 96-start single-question bank
